prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object, check properties, perform task, move to destination - if not visible, scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformTask
	END
